jobs.description:
As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.

• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.

Continuous Improvement:

jobs.occupation: Senior Key Account Manager - Supply Chain & Logistics - Belgium
jobs.description:
Our client is a market-leading European provider of logistics, transportation, and supply chain solutions, serving major international brands across the consumer goods and retail sectors. With a strong presence in Belgium and an extensive European network, the company operates in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment where service quality, customer partnership, and continuous improvement are key drivers of success.With a strong footprint in Belgium and a broader European presence, the organisation is currently going through an important phase of growth. This creates a stimulating environment where commercial teams work closely with operational stakeholders to deliver long-term value for customers and drive continuous improvement across the business.

As Senior Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of major international accounts. Your primary focus will be to strengthen long-term client partnerships, ensure customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Key responsibilities include:

• Acting as the main point of contact for strategic customers across Belgium and Europe.
• Building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders within client organisations.
• Proactively identifying risks, challenges, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
• Leading contract renewals, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and volume agreements.
• Managing customer escalations and coordinating effective solutions with internal stakeholders.
• Working closely with operational teams to ensure service excellence and continuous improvement.
• Monitoring account performance, profitability, and commercial KPIs.
• Coordinating with multiple internal departments and business sites across Belgium.
• Contributing to business development initiatives within existing accounts and identifying selected growth opportunities.

• Strong negotiation skills with exposure to senior decision-makers.
• Solid understanding of logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally B2B environment.
• Ability to navigate complex organisations and manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
• Highly autonomous, proactive, and capable of taking ownership.
• Strong commercial mindset combined with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Solution-oriented with the resilience to manage challenging situations and customer escalations.
• Analytical, structured, and eager to learn.

jobs.occupation: Accounting and Reporting Manager in Brussels
jobs.description:

You will work closely with a variety of stakeholders while ensuring accurate reporting, financial transparency and high-quality service delivery.

In this role, you will oversee accounting and reporting activities for centrally managed costs and third-party managed assets while acting as a trusted finance partner to key stakeholders.

• Partner with central functions such as IT, Legal and other support teams on financial performance and cost management.
• Own the accounting, reporting and control of centrally managed expenditures.
• Manage the reporting and relationship with third-party property owners, ensuring accurate information and timely responses to inquiries.
• Review monthly financial results, analyse variances and provide clear financial insights.
• Coordinate month-end closing activities, reconciliations and intercompany recharges.

• Previous experience managing and developing team members, with a genuine interest in people leadership.

• Experience working in an international, multi-entity or shared services environment is a plus.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Data & AI Impact Consultant Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Data Consultant, you are more than just an executor. You are a cornerstone of our Data & AI Business Unit - technically strong, but also driven to improve your colleagues, clients, and our approach every day.

Specifically:

• You design and build modern data platforms (Azure, Databricks, Data Fabric) with a focus on reusability and AI-readiness.

• You think both customer- and future-oriented: how can we deliver value today and be ready for tomorrow?

• You actively work on your own growth, but also help colleagues grow - through coaching, feedback, or knowledge sharing.

• You have a clear consultancy mindset: supported by (inter)national knowledge, references, and experience, you help our clients reach the next level. You are solution-oriented and leave every client smarter. You work with a partner mindset.

• You take initiative beyond projects to help build Inetum: in client development, talent growth, or community engagement - depending on your strengths.

What we expect from a Consultant

We are looking for someone who recognizes themselves in this profile:

• You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics projects.

• A good knowledge of Dutch and English are mandatory, French is an asset.

• You are familiar with the Azure stack (Data Factory, Synapse, Storage, Purview, Functions) and/or Databricks.

• You think structurally and flexibly: you adapt easily to changing contexts and always seek value for the client.

• You are interested in AI and the role it plays in modern data products (prompt engineering, GenAI, monitoring, automation...).

• You create business impact and understand the outcomes of our work, not just the technical implementations.

• You want to be part of a team - not just participate, but help shape it.

Why join inetum?

• Impactful Career Growth: Work on strategic projects that shape the digital landscape of the public sector.

• Continuous Learning & Development: Access training and certification programs to expand your skills and stay ahead in the industry.

• Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid working options, satellite offices, and a dynamic work environment.

• Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, company car, fuel/charging card, group insurance, hospitalization coverage, and 32 days of annual leave.

• Global Reach with Local Expertise: Be part of an international company with strong local market presence.
